evidence.title: ESR and Colt DCS Announce Joint Venture on New Osaka Data Centre Development
evidence.excerpt: ESR says site preparation is already underway for the joint venture's first phase at a 130 MW Facility Load hyperscale data-centre site in Minoh City; the first phase is 65 MW Facility Load.

metadata.capacity_scope: The release's footnote expressly types both figures as Facility Load. They are represented as planned gross-facility-demand proxies at distinct site and Phase 1 scopes. The 65 MW Phase 1 row is contained within, and is not additive to, the 130 MW site row.

metadata.certification_guardrail: The joint venture is aiming for LEED Gold. This is a future target, not an awarded certification or evidence of completion or operation.
